in_hebrew.long_meaning: Goerke הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Goerke is of Germanic origin and translates to 'guardian' or 'protector'. In Old Germanic, the root word 'gaira' means 'to guard' or 'to protect', while the suffix '-ke' denotes a person or guardian. This name was popular among medieval knights and warriors, who were expected to protect their lands and people.
